title: lantana aculeata f. varia
intro: Lantana aculeata f. varia, commonly known as the Prickly Lantana, is a plant species known for its thorny stems and clusters of small, fragrant flowers. The Prickly Lantana has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in soothing skin irritations and wounds. The bioactive constituents of Lantana aculeata f. varia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
